title: V-204 Equipment Integrity Evaluation
goal: Evaluate mechanical seal wear against plant safety limits

findings.statement: Equipment V-204 seal wear measured at 0.18mm, exceeding 0.10mm limit by +0.08mm (+80%).

decisions.decision: Mandatory replacement of mechanical seal cartridge before re-pressurization
decisions.rationale: Exceeds allowable tolerance per SOP-PV-001 Section 4.2
